summary.en: IDFA, the International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam, runs 12–22 November 2026. DocLab is its twentieth-edition new-media programme, themed Shared Realities, presenting interactive art, VR, games, installations and performances across Amsterdam. The free exhibition at de Brakke Grond is the central meeting point, with more than twenty works; some experiences have limited capacity.

title.en: NewImages Festival 2027 — Open Calls, including XR Development Market
title.zh: NewImages Festival 2027 公开征集（含 XR 开发市场）

summary.en: NewImages, an independent French nonprofit, is accepting submissions for its 2027 Paris edition from 4 September to 22 December 2026. The XR Development Market is for immersive projects still in development: selected teams get four days of curated one-to-one meetings with producers, distributors, cultural institutions, exhibitors and funding bodies, plus eligibility for a 1,000 EUR Best Project Award and two complimentary festival accreditations. Parallel calls cover completed works (XR, Fulldome, Virtual Worlds competitions; Immersive Art Fair) and technology partners.

key_points.en: XR Development Market is for projects in development, not only finished works; apply at newimages.art/application/industry-days.

title.en: Metaverse Standards Forum Volumetric Media Town Hall (includes Gracia AI on 4DGS + WebXR)
title.zh: Metaverse Standards Forum 体积影像市政厅（含 Gracia AI：4DGS 与 WebXR）

summary.en: The Metaverse Standards Forum 3D Asset Working Group's third annual online town hall on the volumetric media industry, with a focus on dynamic 3D Gaussian splatting / 4DGS. Published talks include real-world 4DGS applications (Dymensium), packed Gaussian UV maps for 4D volumetric video (Chronospace), 4DGS streaming and WebXR rendering (Georgii Vysotskii, Gracia AI), open-source 4DGS capture (PlayCanvas / Snap), and a state-of-industry survey (MSF). This is the official 24 November 2026 Gracia AI WebXR talk; it is a session inside this town hall, not a separate Gracia-hosted event.
summary.zh: Metaverse Standards Forum 三维资产工作组的第三届年度线上市政厅，讨论体积影像行业现状，重点是动态 3D 高斯溅射 / 4DGS。已公布的分享包括 Dymensium 的 4DGS 应用、Chronospace 的 4D 体积视频压缩、Gracia AI 的 Georgii Vysotskii 谈 4DGS 流媒体与 WebXR 渲染、PlayCanvas / Snap 的开源 4DGS 采集，以及论坛的行业调查。这就是 2026 年 11 月 24 日 Gracia AI 关于浏览器 XR 的那场分享：它是本场市政厅中的一个环节，并非 Gracia 单独主办的活动。

title.en: World Models in Physical AI — NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
title.zh: 物理 AI 中的世界模型 — NeurIPS 2026 研讨会

summary.en: A one-day NeurIPS 2026 workshop on learned models that simulate, plan and act in the physical world, bringing together generative modeling, reinforcement learning, robotics, computer vision, autonomous driving and simulation. The official site frames world models as a substrate for embodied agents. Co-located challenges are listed (results to be announced at the workshop). Paper schedule is pointed to the official NeurIPS page.
summary.zh: NeurIPS 2026 的一日研讨会，讨论用于在物理世界中模拟、规划与行动的学习模型，汇集生成建模、强化学习、机器人、计算机视觉、自动驾驶与仿真。官方把世界模型视为具身智能体的计算基底。同期列出多项挑战赛，结果将在会上公布。论文日程指向 NeurIPS 官方页面。

key_points.en: 11 December 2026, 08:00-17:00 AEDT, ICC Sydney Room C4.1.
key_points.zh: 2026 年 12 月 11 日 08:00-17:00（澳大利亚东部夏令时），悉尼 ICC C4.1 房间。

key_points.en: Can also be followed via the NeurIPS Virtual Only Pass (live workshop streams).
key_points.zh: 也可通过 NeurIPS Virtual Only Pass 收看工作坊直播。

key_points.en: Focused on world models for robots, vehicles and other embodied agents, not a media-art festival.
key_points.zh: 聚焦机器人、车辆等具身智能的世界模型，不是媒体艺术节。

location.en: In person: Room C4.1, ICC Sydney, Sydney, Australia (NeurIPS 2026 main meeting). NeurIPS also has satellite sites in Atlanta and Paris with workshops on other days; this workshop's published room is Sydney. A NeurIPS Virtual Only Pass includes live streams of workshops.
location.zh: 现场：澳大利亚悉尼 ICC，房间 C4.1（NeurIPS 2026 主会场）。NeurIPS 另有亚特兰大、巴黎卫星会场，其工作坊日程不同；本工作坊公布的房间在悉尼。NeurIPS 的 Virtual Only Pass 含工作坊直播。

fee.en: Attendance requires NeurIPS 2026 registration (workshop days are 11-12 December in Sydney). Official pages confirm a Virtual Only Pass (live streams of conference sessions, tutorials, expos and workshops, plus app interaction) and that any physical registration includes the virtual pass. Guest banquet/reception tickets are $100 USD. Early pricing ended 30-31 October 2026. Dollar amounts for student / academic / industrial and virtual passes were not visible in the static HTML of the pricing page (the table appears to load dynamically). Check neurips.cc/Conferences/2026/Pricing and the registration form for current figures.
fee.zh: 需注册 NeurIPS 2026（悉尼工作坊日为 12 月 11-12 日）。官方确认提供 Virtual Only Pass（含会议、教程、Expo 与工作坊直播及应用内互动），且实体注册含虚拟通行。嘉宾宴会/招待会门票 100 美元。早鸟已于 2026 年 10 月 30-31 日结束。学生/学术/工业及虚拟票的具体美元金额在定价页静态 HTML 中不可见（表格似动态加载），请以 neurips.cc/Conferences/2026/Pricing 与注册表为准。

times_published.en: Friday, 11 December 2026, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM AEDT. Room C4.1, ICC Sydney (workshop site).

title.zh: 圣丹斯电影节 2027 — New Frontier

summary.en: The 2027 Sundance Film Festival debuts in Boulder, 21-31 January. After a two-year pause, New Frontier — the programme at the intersection of art, cinematic storytelling and emerging technologies — returns, with the Dairy Arts Center as its primary home. The official festival blog describes New Frontier as experimental and interdisciplinary; the 2027 lineup had not been posted as of this research. Some competition films (and NEXT, plus other sections that opt in) will have a limited U.S.-only online window late in the festival; New Frontier's inclusion in that online programme is not stated.
summary.zh: 2027 年圣丹斯电影节于 1 月 21-31 日首次在博尔德举办。时隔两年，处于艺术、电影叙事与新兴技术交叉处的 New Frontier 单元回归，主场地为 Dairy Arts Center。官方博客将其描述为实验性、跨学科；截至本次调研，2027 年片单尚未公布。部分竞赛影片（以及 NEXT，及其他自愿参加的单元）在影节末期有仅限美国的线上窗口；官方并未写明 New Frontier 是否进入该线上节目。

key_points.en: New Frontier returns in Boulder, primarily at the Dairy Arts Center, 21-31 January 2027.
key_points.zh: New Frontier 于 2027 年 1 月 21-31 日在博尔德回归，主场地为 Dairy Arts Center。

key_points.en: Lineup expected in December 2026; New Frontier hours and ticket type not yet itemised.
key_points.zh: 片单预计 2026 年 12 月公布；New Frontier 的开放时间与专票尚未单列。

key_points.en: Do not assume New Frontier is in the U.S. online festival window — that has not been announced.
key_points.zh: 不要假定 New Frontier 包含在美国线上展映窗口——官方尚未宣布。

location.en: In person in Boulder, Colorado, USA. Official festival blog: the Dairy Arts Center is a screening venue and the primary home for the return of New Frontier. Street address was not captured on the pages opened for this research.

All-in prices inclusive of fees as published. Single film tickets $37, on sale starting 8 January 2027. A New Frontier-specific ticket price is not listed. Online streaming is only available within the United States and U.S. territories.

times_published.en: Festival in person 21-31 January 2027, Boulder, Colorado. World premieres 21-26 January. Lineup to be announced in December 2026.

summary.en: ISE is a large professional audiovisual and systems-integration trade show. The 2027 edition, themed When Worlds Unite, runs 2-5 February at Fira Gran Via, Barcelona, with Creative Industries among its interest areas. An Attendee Ticket covers four days on the show floor plus the Spark and EdTech Congress floors at Montjuic. This is a broad AV expo; the more creative/immersive counterpart is Spark (3-4 February).
summary.zh: ISE 是大型专业视听与系统集成贸易展。2027 年主题为 When Worlds Unite，2 月 2-5 日在巴塞罗那 Fira Gran Via 举行，兴趣领域包括创意产业。观众票覆盖四天展厅，并含 Montjuic 的 Spark 与 EdTech Congress 展区。这是宽口径的 AV 大展；更偏创意与沉浸内容的是同期的 Spark（2 月 3-4 日）。

key_points.en: Attendee access includes Spark show floors; Spark Conference requires a higher content pass.

summary.en: Spark is a two-day creative-industries event alongside ISE, focused on content, tools and experiences rather than AV infrastructure alone. Official themes include creative convergence, new tools (AI, real-time, immersive and virtual technologies), new audiences, and the future of creative work. The site lists immersive showcases, XR and interactive experiences among what attendees can explore.
summary.zh: Spark 是与 ISE 同期的两日创意产业活动，重点是内容、工具与体验，而不是单纯的 AV 基建。官方主题包括创意融合、新工具（AI、实时、沉浸与虚拟技术）、新观众，以及创意工作的未来。网站把沉浸展示、XR 与互动体验列为参观内容。

summary.en: SXSW's XR Experience presents virtual, augmented and mixed-reality projects that emphasise storytelling and art. Official pages describe Competition, Spotlight and Special Events sections. The 2027 exhibition is listed for 17-19 March at Fairmont Manchester, during SXSW in Austin (15-21 March). Project types named on the application page include VR/MR, AR, immersive performance, projection installations, immersive audio and AI-based installations.

The 29th edition is 7-9 April 2027 in Laval, France, with an exhibition (Mayenne Hall, Pegase Hall, LBVR Area) and conferences, tech talks and a doctoral consortium. The official pages describe an in-person visit to Espace Mayenne; no live online ticket is listed.

key_points.en: 7-9 April 2027, Espace Mayenne, Laval, France, with published daily hours.

fee.en: Super Early Bird until 31 January; Early Bird 1 February-15 March; regular 16 March-9 April. Full Pass: 390 / 520 / 520 EUR. Discovery Pass (exhibition): 155 / 210 / 210 EUR, with optional Sessions add-on listed in places as excl. VAT (e.g. +95 EUR i.e. 200 EUR excl. VAT in the Super Early Bird column). A reduced Discovery Pass exists for students (minimum third year of higher education) and jobseekers, with proof required. Passes cover all three days; no day pass. Passes cannot be refunded or exchanged. Whether the headline Full/Discovery prices include VAT is not clearly stated on the ticketing page (some add-ons are explicitly excl. VAT).

summary.en: NewImages Festival returns to Paris 21-25 April 2027 for immersive art, digital creation and new storytelling, with Industry Days 20-23 April. The official 2027 page promises a selection of VR, AR, interactive, digital, dome, virtual-world and hybrid works, plus a professional platform covering development, co-production, exhibition and circulation. Open calls are already running (see the companion card).

location.en: Cite des sciences et de l'industrie, 30 avenue Corentin Cariou, 75019 Paris, France. Official practical info: Panorama at ground-level Vestibule; XR Competition at Le Loft (level -2); Virtual Worlds, work in progress, school projects and FabLab at Carrefour Numerique (level -1); Dome Competition at the Planetarium (level +2); Industry Days and XR Development Market at Centre des congres de la Villette (level -1).

fee.en: Professional accreditation prices are already listed, but Registration will open soon: Student Pass 15 EUR VAT exempt; NewImages Pass 120 EUR VAT exempt; Insider Pass 350 EUR VAT exempt; press accreditation by request to press@newimages.art. The 2027 festival page says public ticketing information will be announced soon — do not assume the 2026 public exhibition was free again until 2027 ticketing is published. A dedicated Immersive Storytelling and Events page describes VR, augmented worlds and immersive events, but it does not yet publish a 2027 immersive lineup or venues. times_published.en: Official ticket listing: event start 14 June 2027 09:00 AM (PST); event end 17 June 2027 04:30 PM (PST). The site labels the timezone as PST even though mid-June in California is normally Pacific Daylight Time (UTC-7). Converted times below follow the published PST label and flag that uncertainty.
times_published.zh: 官方售票信息：2027 年 6 月 14 日上午 09:00 开始（标为 PST）；2027 年 6 月 17 日下午 04:30 结束（标为 PST）。页面在 6 月中旬仍标 PST，而加州此时通常是太平洋夏令时间（UTC−7）。下面的换算按页面所标的 PST，并标出这一不确定。

display_times.en: Converted from the PST (UTC−8) label on the ticket listing: the published window runs from 01:00 on 14 Jun to 08:30 on 18 Jun (UTC+8). That is the start and end of the whole event, not a daily timetable. If local time is actually PDT (UTC−7), shift one hour earlier (about 00:00 on 14 Jun to 07:30 on 18 Jun, UTC+8). Use the official agenda for the daily schedule.
display_times.zh: 若按售票页所标 PST（UTC-8）换算：6 月 14 日 01:00 至 6 月 18 日 08:30（UTC+8）为整段活动窗口的起止，而非每日时刻表。若当地实际为 PDT（UTC-7），起止应再提前一小时（约 6 月 14 日 00:00 至 6 月 18 日 07:30，UTC+8）。每日分时日程请以官方议程为准。

source_timezone.en: Published as PST on the official ticket listing. Typical local time in Long Beach in June is PDT (UTC-7); this was not relabelled by the organiser on the pages opened.
source_timezone.zh: 售票信息标为 PST。长滩 6 月的当地时间通常是 PDT（UTC−7）；已打开的页面没有改标。

format_notes.en: The About page describes a London festival with visitors coming into the city. No official online attendance option for 2027 VRX/Immersive was listed on the pages opened.
format_notes.zh: About 页按人们前来伦敦参加的影节来写。已打开的页面未列出 2027 年 VRX/Immersive 的官方线上参加方式。

summary.en: The 35th Raindance Film Festival, the UK's largest independent film festival, runs from opening night 16 June to closing night 25 June 2027 in London. Official festival sections include a world programme of independent films, House of Raindance talks, and a Raindance VRX programme for virtual reality and new media. Awards listed include Raindance Immersive Awards. raindanceimmersive.com currently shows a list of project titles without 2027 dates or ticketing.
summary.zh: 第 35 届 Raindance 电影节是英国最大的独立电影节，2027 年 6 月 16 日开幕、6 月 25 日闭幕，在伦敦举行。官方单元包括独立电影节目、House of Raindance 对谈，以及面向虚拟现实与新媒体的 Raindance VRX 节目。奖项名单中包括 Raindance Immersive Awards。raindanceimmersive.com 目前只列出项目名称，没有 2027 年日期或票务。

key_points.en: 16-25 June 2027 in London (opening and closing nights as published).
key_points.zh: 2027 年 6 月 16-25 日在伦敦（开闭幕夜已公布）。

key_points.en: Official sections include Raindance VRX (VR and new media) and Immersive Awards.
key_points.zh: 官方单元包括 Raindance VRX（VR 与新媒体）以及 Immersive Awards。

key_points.en: 2027 venues, hours and fees are not yet on the About page.
key_points.zh: 2027 年场地、时刻与费用尚未写在 About 页上。

location.en: London, United Kingdom. The About page situates the festival in London's West End film district. The listed address 40 Craven Street, London WC2N 5NG is the Raindance head office, not a confirmed screening venue.
location.zh: 英国伦敦。About 页将影节放在伦敦西区电影区。所列 40 Craven Street, London WC2N 5NG 是 Raindance 总部地址，不是已确认的放映场地。

fee.en: Not listed on the official About page opened for this research. Public ticket or accreditation prices for 2027 were not published there.
fee.zh: 未公布。本次打开的官方 About 页没有 2027 年公众票或证件价格。

times_published.en: Opening Night 16 June 2027; Closing Night 25 June 2027. Daily hours and immersive-venue times are not listed on the About page.
times_published.zh: 开幕夜 2027 年 6 月 16 日；闭幕夜 2027 年 6 月 25 日。About 页没有列出每日钟点或沉浸场地时间。

display_times.en: Opening night 16 Jun 2027 and closing night 25 Jun (London). Daily showtimes are not on the About page, so no UTC+8 clock is shown.
display_times.zh: 2027 年 6 月 16 日开幕、6 月 25 日闭幕（伦敦）。每日场次钟点未在 About 页公布，故不换算 UTC+8 具体钟点。

format_notes.en: The About page invites people to Anaheim and does not advertise a virtual pass. Unlike SIGGRAPH Asia 2026, there is no explicit no-virtual-access FAQ yet — but no online option is listed either, so the label is in-person, not hybrid.
format_notes.zh: About 页邀请人们前往阿纳海姆，并未宣传线上通行证。与 SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 不同，目前也还没有「不提供线上」的 FAQ——但同样未列出线上选项，故标为线下，而不是混合办。

summary.en: ACM SIGGRAPH's 2027 North American conference on computer graphics and interactive techniques will be held 8-12 August at the Anaheim Convention Center. The official description covers visual storytelling, digital art, robotics, digital twins, AI, immersive media and real-time technologies, plus an exhibition and industry sessions. Programme and registration details were still thin on the About page at the time of research.
summary.zh: ACM SIGGRAPH 2027 年北美计算机图形与交互技术大会将于 8 月 8-12 日在阿纳海姆会议中心举行。官方描述涵盖视觉叙事、数字艺术、机器人、数字孪生、人工智能、沉浸媒体与实时技术，并包括展览与产业场次。截至本次调研，About 页上的节目与注册细节仍然很少。

key_points.en: 8-12 August 2027, Anaheim Convention Center, California.
key_points.zh: 2027 年 8 月 8-12 日，加州阿纳海姆会议中心。

key_points.en: Immersive media and real-time technologies are named in the official overview.
key_points.zh: 官方概述点名了沉浸媒体与实时技术。

key_points.en: Fees and daily hours not yet on the About page.
key_points.zh: 票价与每日开放时间尚未写在 About 页上。

location.en: Anaheim Convention Center, 800 W. Katella Ave., Anaheim, California, USA (800 West Katella Avenue, Anaheim, CA 92802 as also printed on the About page).
location.zh: 美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆会议中心，800 W. Katella Ave., Anaheim, CA 92802。

fee.en: Not listed on the About page opened for this research. A Register page exists at s2027.siggraph.org/register/; prices were not captured here.
fee.zh: 未公布。本次打开的 About 页没有票价。注册页为 s2027.siggraph.org/register/，此处未抓到价格。

times_published.en: Sunday 8 August through Thursday 12 August 2027. Daily door-opening clock times are not listed on the About page.
times_published.zh: 2027 年 8 月 8 日（周日）至 8 月 12 日（周四）。About 页没有列出每日开门钟点。

display_times.en: 8–12 Aug 2027 in Anaheim. Daily hours are not on the About page, so no UTC+8 clock is shown. Local time in August is usually Pacific Daylight Time.
display_times.zh: 2027 年 8 月 8-12 日（阿纳海姆）。About 页未公布每日开闭馆钟点，故不换算 UTC+8 具体钟点。当地 8 月通常为太平洋夏令时间。

source_timezone.en: America/Los_Angeles (PDT, UTC-7 in August — not labelled on the About page, inferred from the Anaheim venue)
source_timezone.zh: America/Los_Angeles（8 月为 PDT，UTC−7。About 页没有标注时区，此时区是按阿纳海姆会场推断的）
